$comment: Sheet definitions for scripts/process_art_assets.js. Each sheet is cut into an even rows x cols grid; each named cell is alpha-matted, trimmed and written to client/assets/<pack>/<name>.png. anchorY: 0 = feet/bottom (characters, pets), 0.5 = centered. faces: which way the DRAWING looks ('right' = toward screen right / down-right / up-right, 'left' = the opposite). The renderer mirrors a sprite only when its native facing differs from the direction the character should look, so this MUST match the art. Views: <id>_front (Front-3/4), <id>_side (pure profile), <id>_back (Back-3/4).
